scope: Minimal new-name owners for separately authorized candidate actions. One solver OR one offline reader per invocation, never both or an automatic next stage. No build,production edit,input rewrite,old-result overwrite or retained control rerun.
smoke: flux_smoke_run -ExecutionAuthorized: use logs/upl_case02_flux_actual_DebugCPU_r1.helper.json and unchanged upl_case02_smoke_r1.inputs.json/runtime/BI4/Normals; true --solver smoke with original2steps/3frames. New tag upl_case02_flux_smoke_r1. Existing old smoke pass is not this candidate's pass.
short: flux_short_run -Window coarse|half: use new flux_actual_ReleaseCPU_r1 helper and unchanged short_r1.inputs jobs. Original coarse5000/half10000 steps and519frames to .0125 are unchanged. Tags upl_case02_flux_short_coarse_r1 and upl_case02_flux_short_half_r1; one fresh solve only,no PART restart.
new_QC_prerequisites: Both short windows require new flux_smoke_r1.qc.json and flux_legacy_off_r1.exact.json. Half additionally requires new flux_short_coarse_r1.native.check.json plus flux_short_coarse_r1.qc.json with nonempty drainage. QC must be passed stage upl_case02_flux_qc_r1 with correct mode,bindings_unchanged_after_QC and inputs binding the corresponding new native.check/solver.run Entries. Missing or false new gates stop before solver; no old passed gate is substituted.
OFF: flux_legacy_off_run -ExecutionAuthorized: new logs/upl_case02_flux_cpu_ReleaseCPU_r1.build.json main program, fresh output/tag upl_case02_flux_legacy_off_r1, original -cpu stable/mdbc and2001steps/21frames. Reuse exactly the four sealed prepared config/runtime/BI4/Normals Entries from old legacy_off_r1.run.json; no seed copy,XML edit,GenCase or old151frame run. The existing .02s runtime retains original OFF HG/SPR/viscosity/damping and actual retained clock convention.
OFF_runtime: Use the four actually successful sealed old OFF runtime copies after checking both old source/copy and same-name current bin/windows bytes/SHA. Copy into the new isolated flux-main executable directory only when missing. An existing same-hash copy is reused; a differing copy is rejected,never overwritten. No canonical program/runtime installation.
native: flux_native_review -Job smoke|legacy_off|short_coarse|short_half: locate upl_case02_flux_{Job}_r1 solver output and emit that tag's native.check.json with check.job='flux_'+Job. Samples/dt/modes remain3/2.5us,--read for smoke;519/2.5us or1.25us for short;21/10us,--read-off for OFF. No legacy_control selector: retain its already decoded151frames unchanged.
structural_reader: Reuse actual passed logs/upl_case02_reader_ReleaseCPU_r2.helper.json357285B SHA51b88f7431ce6afc7de621baf1ecd0540d55d7faebdde17093093950ad78fece and its sealed program,calls,authors,runtime. It is an offline structural reader,not claimed to share the new solver source build. Do not reinterpret its historical CPU.cpp original as current source or rebuild/redecode the old control.
ownership: Each solver writes a new .solver.call.json; each offline reader writes a new .reader.call.json. Direct call resets LASTEXITCODE,captures the actual typed exit immediately,and seals that owned call before any output enumeration/hash/completion parsing. Later wrapper failure never erases the actual call record or causes a solver rerun. Run/native result retains top-level direct/typed/owned fields plus owned_exit_record Entry for the existing QC loader.
bindings: Pre/post verify selected new build/program,author/note,input/config/runtime and current source/snapshot/doc pairs; preserve seven canonical programs for solver actions. Native verifies sealed solver input/files plus independent reader closure without claiming same-build physics. All selected output folders/logs/call/results must be fresh; post-call failures preserve evidence.
fresh_paths: Run outputs tests/outputs/{tag},logs/{tag}.log/.solver.call.json/.run.json. Native outputs tests/outputs/{tag}_native,logs/{tag}.native.log/.reader.call.json/.native.check.json. No automatic QC file is created by these owners.
limits: Solver exit/final-state or native structural pass does not establish a QC/independent-half/theory/force-stage-load/long/formal/GPU/Cryer/variable-k/physical acceptance. Root fully reads authors,then explicitly executes each action in gate order. Post-Run dterror may be a reset-interval sentinel,not a full-history safety maximum.
